title: •Desilijic Tattoo
caption: •Desilijic Tattoo (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Bounty Hunters and your {independent} starships are defense value +1 and forfeit +2. Once per turn, when a bounty hunter uses a non-{lightsaber} weapon to hit a character, target is forfeit -2 and opponent places top card of Reserve Deck in Lost Pile. {alter}
lore: Jabba The Hutt’s clan requires all members to carry ritual scarring identifying them forever as heirs to the Nal Hutta legacy. These tattoos are considered marks of power.

notes: Unique. Inline blue spoked-wheel square before 'starships' = Independent starship icon → {independent} (stub: 'Independent starships'). Inline black square with a green blade after 'non-' transcribed as {lightsaber} per this run's instructions (the GEMP text reads '[Permanent Weapon]' and STANDARD.md rev 8 calls this icon the Permanent Weapon icon — same glyph). Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. 'Bounty Hunters' capitalised as on the slip. Lore corrected from scan: 'Jabba The Hutt’s' with capital The and curly apostrophe (wiki 'Jabba the Hutt's'). Base scan only at 350 px; Special Edition copyright line taken as the SE form, year 1998, not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
